textual.observation: The description invites viewers to join BitConnect through a shortened URL while appending an incomplete "3%" term; the speaker also describes the platform as serious and says they personally invested money.

evidence.quote: Join the team at bitConnect -- https://goo.gl/bhHBYq 3% ...
This platform is, as I said, one of the few that is very serious.
meanwhile I have personally invest money because I will then also make separate videos

textual.context: The description reads as a promotional invitation. The ASR presents the speaker's own investment and positive view of the platform; the meaning of the incomplete "3%" term is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: The explicit invitation to join is paired with an incomplete 3% claim and a positive personal-investment endorsement, creating a reward/action/endorsement relationship requiring later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The description ends with "3% ..." and does not establish the amount's meaning, timeframe, guarantee, recipient, or conditions. These records do not verify the shortened URL, the speaker's identity, the investment, or any transaction outcome.

visual.observation: A German-language webpage branded "Genesis Mining" visibly pairs the claim "Über 500.000 Kunden vertrauen..." with the headline "BITCOIN MINING FÜR ALLE!" and a "JETZT MINING STARTEN!" button.
visual.context: Promotional webpage presentation; from the sampled frames, it is unclear whether the video is advertising, reviewing, or demonstrating the site.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible customer-trust claim is directly paired with a call to start bitcoin mining, creating an endorsement-to-action relationship that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the customer claim is accurate, whether payment or account creation occurs, or whether any mining service or outcome is delivered; unseen clicks and speech cannot be assessed.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker acknowledges possible negative reports or concern about the platform while continuing to describe it positively.

visual_context_notes.observation: The candidate appears on a German-language webpage with visible navigation, informational text, and call-to-action buttons.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitConnect participation by directing viewers to "Join the team" through an external link and attaching a 3% claim to that invitation. The speaker presents BitConnect as one of the few platforms that is "very serious," says he personally invested money, and promises to demonstrate how it works, which actively encourages viewers to trust and participate in the investment platform.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central mechanism is promotion of participation in an investment/lending platform associated with a stated 3% benefit. The video combines an investment invitation, a return-related claim, positive safety assurance, and the speaker's claimed personal investment; it does not merely discuss cryptocurrency markets or provide a neutral wallet tutorial.
